items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Paul then told me that he had discovered Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Yeah? Did you know John Hammond’s name at the time?
No. I didn’t know the significance until Paul then told me that he had discovered Benny Goodman and who else, Basie.
And Dylan later and all that.
